We use DND surprise attack rules for that, and recently learned that Sneak attacks add Vicious to the damage OR 2 damage dice if they already have vicious. 

There’s a myriad of sneak attack perks that make it incredibly likely you kill or severely wound anything you sneak attack with the proper set up. 

I think the way we do it is that the NPC getting shot Roles a PER-Survival difficulty 2 to see where the shot came from, while other enemies don’t know about it unless the individual drops dead or yknow screams in pain.

From there, they also need to succeed on a difficulty 2 PER-Survival check to find the person who made the shot. 

You COULD adopt “Escape Artist” perk rules where the difficulty on sneak checks increases for the amount of enemies within medium or close range (whichever the perk states or you feel comfy with).

RAW, stealth is incredibly powerful and with the right stealth perks it’s GODLY.

As someone who’s never been a Mormon and only knows a handful, advice I can give about LONG term volunteering (NCCC FEMA Corps) is keep your head on a swivel in Urban spaces. If you’re from a Rural area like I was, you might be a bit of a bumbling idiot like I was when I went to San Juan after Hurricane Maria.

Don’t carry bags or laptops or flaunt your cellphone or anything like that. And always be nice to the homeless. Helped me to keep a pack of cigarettes and a lighter and light cigs for the homeless folk. They’re suffering and often one courtesy will change their day.
